title: Tensor relation cokernel presentation of change of rings
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $B,C$ sheaves of commutative $\mathcal O_Y$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-comm-algebra-sheaf], $\varphi:B\to C$ an algebra morphism, and $P$ a sheaf of $B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $P_0$ for restriction of scalars to $\mathcal O_Y$, and $B_0,C_0$ for the underlying $\mathcal O_Y$-modules of the algebras. Use the sheaf tensor product and change of rings [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], put $S=C_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}P_0$ and $F=B_0\otimes_{\mathcal O_Y}S$, and let $\tau(c,p)$ denote the canonical pure tensor section of $S$. There exist an $\mathcal O_Y$-linear map $\delta:F\to S$ and an $\mathcal O_Y$-module isomorphism $e:(C\otimes_B P)|_{\mathcal O_Y}\to\operatorname{coker}(\delta)$ such that on every open $W$, for $b\in B(W)$, $c\in C(W)$ and $p\in P(W)$, $\delta_W(b\otimes\tau(c,p))=\tau(c,bp)-\tau(\varphi_W(b)c,p)$ and $e_W(\eta_W(c\otimes_Bp))=q_W(\tau(c,p))$. Here $q:S\to\operatorname{coker}(\delta)$ is the categorical cokernel projection and $\eta$ is the change-of-rings sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. No quasi-coherence hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: Obtain a,d:F->S and g:S->T with the pure tensor formulas and a followed by g = d followed by g from the action-map construction. Set delta=a-d. Preadditivity implies delta followed by g=0.

Put q=cokernel.pi delta. Since delta followed by q=0, a followed by q=d followed by q. Apply the balancing universal property to q to obtain h:T->cokernel delta with g followed by h=q. The cokernel universal property gives k:cokernel delta->T with q followed by k=g.

The balancing universal property applied to g makes both h followed by k and the identity the unique factor of g, so h followed by k=id. Cancel the epic q to show k followed by h=id from q followed by k followed by h=g followed by h=q. These morphisms define the required isomorphism e.

Evaluation of delta=a-d on pure tensor sections, using the action formulas and Hom.sub_app, gives the displayed relation formula. Evaluation of g followed by h=q and the section formula for g gives the required formula for e.hom on the change-of-rings unit.

theorem changeOfRings_tensor_relation_presentation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : Y.CommAlgebraSheaf) (φ : B ⟶ C)
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (𝓡 B.right)) :
    let P₀ := (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 B.hom)).obj P
    let S := tensorObj C.toModule P₀
    ∃ (δ : tensorObj B.toModule S ⟶ S)
      (e : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝓻 C.hom)).obj
        (SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u} φ.right P) ≅ cokernel δ),
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op W))
          (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        δ.app W (tmulSection (M := B.toModule) b
          (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p)) =
          tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c (b • p) -
            tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) (φ.right.hom.app (op W) b * c) p) ∧
      (∀ (W : Y.Opens) (c : C.right.obj.obj (op W)) (p : P.val.obj (op W)),
        e.hom.val.app (op W)
          ((((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 (𝓡 C.right).obj)).unit.app
            (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{u, u, u} φ.right P)).app (op W))
              (c ⊗ₜ[B.right.obj.obj (op W), (φ.right.hom.app (op W)).hom] p)) =
          (cokernel.π δ).app W (tmulSection (M := C.toModule) (N := P₀) c p))
